overview_description.description: Kilimanjaro Energy, Inc., a research and development company, engages in the demonstration, commercialization, and promulgation of the air-capture technology for the capture of carbon dioxide (CO2) from the atmosphere. It focuses on the development of ACCESS, an atmospheric carbon capture system. The company was formerly known as Global Research Technologies, LLC. Kilimanjaro Energy was founded in 2004 and is based in Waukesha, Wisconsin with a development and business presence in New York, New York, as well as administrative offices, a research laboratory, and a prototype development and demonstration area in Tucson, Arizona.
